source.title: The london first-bar follow on NQ (Claude, 2026-10-20): JJ's opening-candle idea at the engine's london pass

entry.words: The first 15-minute bar of the London session (03:00-03:15 ET) closes up: market long at 03:15; closes down: short. Stop 30 points, target 30 points (1:1), once a day, flat at the pass's end (08:25). JJ's opening-candle idea at the 03:00 open (the vault: the 03:00 candle follows, the 02:00 one fails).
